output.reason: [ev-685e81f5b751] is a one-line changelog entry. It only says `.status.crossplane.connectionDetails` was removed from the modern XR schema. It does not say what happens to environments that read or rely on that field. It is also a status field written by Crossplane, not a value the operator configures, so "setting-ignored" (a configured value that stops being honoured) is not supported and would over-claim mandatory work. To decide, we need the PR #6655 description or the v2 upgrade notes stating what changes for readers of this status field, such as connection details now being exposed another way.
